acquisition method: The top 20 intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell
cleavage agent: digested on the 30 kDa filter unit (Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany) over night with trypsin at pH = 8.0
collision energy: fragmentation in the HCD cell at normalized collision energy of 27%
enrichment method: peptides were incubated with TiO2 beads (GL sciences, Tokyo, Japan)
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus via a nano-electrospray ion source
ionization type: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus via a nano-electrospray ion source
labeling: By employing a label-free; MS (Mass Spectrometry)-based phosphoproteomic approach
